verdict.rationale: Gusto documents its own business formation flow: owners can form a company or LLC, register for an EIN, and open a bank account in one guided flow. That covers the state filing portion of the story, but the feature is in early beta, and the evidence mentions only LLC formation, not Delaware corporate incorporation. Missing for 10: Delaware C-corp incorporation specifically, bylaws generation, initial board approvals/consents, general availability beyond early beta, independent or hands-on corroboration of the formation flow.
